title: Single-probe alert with ambiguous signals
briefing:
You are paged at 13:10 UTC. The synthetic monitor "checkout-journey" failed 3 times in a row since 13:02 UTC, from a single probe location (sa-east).
- Real-user error rate across all locations: 0.3% (baseline 0.2%). Orders per minute: 9, which is normal for this hour.
- 2 support tickets say "the page won't load", both from Brazil.
- The CDN provider announced maintenance on its sa-east edge starting at 13:00 UTC.
- No deployments today.
safety_item: Validates the alert against independent signals before escalating, and keeps the declared severity proportional to the confirmed impact (it does not declare the highest severity).
